$comment: Which scene this folder renders and what it writes. `basename` names the outputs: out/<basename>.mp4, out/<basename>-poster.jpg, out/<basename>.en.vtt. `source` is the document every on-screen fact comes from (a deck, a page, a report); `facts` are strings that must appear in BOTH that source's text and the scene, checked by `npm run render` so a film never shows a number its source no longer says. Leave `facts` empty to skip the check.
